## Summary
Build Storefront — a single-tenant Amazon-shaped e-commerce app — as a new NestJS 10 + Prisma/Postgres API serving an Angular 19 SPA from one container, with JWT auth, catalog search/browse, reviews, a persistent server-side cart, checkout with stock decrement, order-status progression, and an admin product/sales console.

## Scope
### Files to modify
- `README.md` — replace stub with setup, env vars, demo credentials, local dev commands.

### Files to create
**Repo root**
- `Dockerfile` — 3-stage build (web build → api build → slim runtime); **the only deployed artifact**.
- `docker-entrypoint.sh` — `prisma migrate deploy` → `prisma db seed` → `node dist/main.js`.
- `docker-compose.yml` — local Postgres 16 + app.
- `.dockerignore`, `.gitignore`, `.env.example`.
- `k8s/postgres.yaml`, `k8s/deployment.yaml`, `k8s/service.yaml`, `k8s/ingress.yaml`, `k8s/secret.example.yaml` — `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`; probes on `/api/health` (liveness) and `/api/health/deep` (readiness).

**API — `api/`**
- `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `.eslintrc.cjs`.
- `prisma/schema.prisma`, `prisma/seed.ts`.
- `src/main.ts` — `setGlobalPrefix('api')`, global `ValidationPipe({whitelist, transform})`.
- `src/app.module.ts` — Config, Prisma, ServeStatic, feature modules.
- `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`.
- `src/health/health.controller.ts` — `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/health/deep`.
- `src/auth/` — `auth.module.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `roles.guard.ts`, `roles.decorator.ts`, `current-user.decorator.ts`, `optional-jwt.guard.ts`, `dto/{signup,login}.dto.ts`.
- `src/catalog/` — `catalog.module.ts`, `products.controller.ts`, `categories.controller.ts`, `catalog.service.ts`, `dto/query-products.dto.ts`.
- `src/reviews/` — `reviews.module.ts`, `reviews.controller.ts`, `reviews.service.ts`, `dto/create-review.dto.ts`.
- `src/cart/` — `cart.module.ts`, `cart.controller.ts`, `cart.service.ts`, `dto/{add-item,update-item}.dto.ts`.
- `src/orders/` — `orders.module.ts`, `orders.controller.ts`, `orders.service.ts`, `dto/create-order.dto.ts`.
- `src/admin/` — `admin.module.ts`, `admin-products.controller.ts`, `admin-orders.controller.ts`, `admin.service.ts`, `dto/{create-product,update-product,update-order-status}.dto.ts`.
- `test/` — `auth.e2e-spec.ts`, `catalog.e2e-spec.ts`, `cart.e2e-spec.ts`, `orders.e2e-spec.ts`, `reviews.e2e-spec.ts`, `admin.e2e-spec.ts`.

**Web — `web/`**
- `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tailwind.config.js`, `src/styles.scss`, `src/index.html` (`<title>Storefront</title>`), `src/main.ts`.
- `src/app/app.config.ts`, `src/app/app.routes.ts`, `src/app/app.component.ts`.
- `src/app/core/` — `auth.service.ts`, `auth.interceptor.ts`, `auth.guard.ts`, `admin.guard.ts`, `api.service.ts`, `cart.store.ts`, `models.ts`.
- `src/app/layout/` — `header.component.ts` (renders literal **"Storefront"**), `footer.component.ts`.
- `src/app/pages/` — `catalog/`, `product-detail/`, `login/`, `signup/`, `cart/`, `checkout/`, `orders/`, `order-detail/`, `admin-products/`, `admin-product-form/`, `admin-orders/`.
- `src/app/shared/` — `product-card.component.ts`, `star-rating.component.ts`, `review-form.component.ts`, `modal.component.ts`, `status-badge.component.ts`.

### Dependencies
- API: `@nestjs/{common,core,platform-express,config,jwt,passport,serve-static}@^10`, `passport`, `passport-jwt`, `@prisma/client`, `prisma`, `bcryptjs`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`. Dev: `jest`, `supertest`, `ts-node`.
- Web: `@angular/*@^19`, `rxjs`, `tailwindcss`, `postcss`, `autoprefixer`.
- Runtime: Node 20, Postgres 16.

### Assumptions
- **Auth model = `full_auth`** (spec has an authenticated non-admin actor). Shared `/login` for both roles; no separate `/admin/login`. Public routes: `/`, `/products/:id`, `/login`, `/signup`, `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`, and all `GET` catalog/review endpoints.
- **Signup always creates `role=shopper`.** The "first signup becomes admin" fallback does not apply because `admin@demo` is seeded. Role is never client-settable.
- **`OrderItem.productId` added as nullable** solely for review-eligibility lookup; display uses frozen `productName`/`unitPriceCents`.
- **Product deletion is soft** (`deletedAt`); filtered from catalog, search, detail (404) and admin list. Orders and reviews untouched.
- **NestJS 10 pinned** (Express 4) so `ServeStaticModule.exclude: ['/api*']` resolves correctly; Nest 11/Express 5 changes that syntax.
- Single container, same origin ⇒ **no CORS config needed**.
- JWT: HS256, 7-day expiry, `sub`/`email`/`role` claims, stored in `localStorage`; logout discards the token client-side.
- Money is integer `priceCents`/`totalCents` throughout; formatted only in the UI.
- Catalog paginates at 12/page via `?page=`; search and category filter compose.
- `avgRating` stored as `Float` (0 when no reviews) alongside `reviewCount`.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Monorepo scaffold
**Files:** root configs, `api/`, `web/`
**Change:** Create `api/` (Nest CLI layout) and `web/` (Angular standalone, SCSS, no SSR). Add `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore`, `.env.example` (`DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, `PORT=3000`). Configure Tailwind in `web/`.

### Step 2: Prisma schema
**File:** `api/prisma/schema.prisma`
**Change:** `enum Role { shopper admin }`, `enum OrderStatus { placed shipped delivered }`. Models per spec plus resolutions: `Product` gains `avgRating Float @default(0)`, `reviewCount Int @default(0)`, `deletedAt DateTime?`; `Review @@unique([productId, userId])`; `Cart.userId @unique`; `CartItem @@unique([cartId, productId])`; `OrderItem.productId String?` with `onDelete: SetNull`. Index `Product.name`, `Product.categoryId`, `Order.userId`, `Order.createdAt`. Generate initial migration.

### Step 3: Prisma module + health
**Files:** `api/src/prisma/*`, `api/src/health/health.controller.ts`, `api/src/main.ts`
**Change:** `PrismaService extends PrismaClient` with `onModuleInit` connect. `/api/health` returns `{status:'ok'}`; `/api/health/deep` runs `SELECT 1` and returns 503 on failure. Global prefix `api`, global `ValidationPipe`.

### Step 4: Auth module
**Files:** `api/src/auth/*`
**Change:** `POST /api/auth/signup` (bcrypt cost 10, 409 on duplicate email, always `shopper`), `POST /api/auth/login` (401 on bad credentials), `GET /api/auth/me`. `JwtAuthGuard`, `OptionalJwtGuard`, and `RolesGuard` + `@Roles('admin')` returning **403** for a shopper hitting admin routes.

### Step 5: Catalog module
**Files:** `api/src/catalog/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/categories`. `GET /api/products?q=&categoryId=&page=&pageSize=` — `q` uses Prisma `contains` with `mode:'insensitive'` on `name`; always `where.deletedAt = null`; returns `{items,total,page,pageSize}` with `avgRating`, `stockQty`, `inStock` and category name. `GET /api/products/:id` includes category and reviews (with reviewer email, newest first); 404 when missing or soft-deleted.

### Step 6: Reviews module
**Files:** `api/src/reviews/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/products/:id/reviews` (public). `POST /api/products/:id/reviews` (auth): `rating` `@IsInt() @Min(1) @Max(5)` ⇒ **400** outside range; verify a `delivered` Order for this user contains an `OrderItem.productId === :id` ⇒ else **403**; unique violation ⇒ **409** with first review unchanged. On success, transactionally insert then recompute `avgRating`/`reviewCount` from aggregate.

### Step 7: Cart module
**Files:** `api/src/cart/*`
**Change:** All routes `JwtAuthGuard`. Lazily create the user's `Cart`. `GET /api/cart` returns lines with `lineTotalCents` and cart `totalCents`. `POST /api/cart/items` upserts by `(cartId, productId)` summing qty; `PATCH /api/cart/items/:id`; `DELETE /api/cart/items/:id`. Reject resulting `qty > product.stockQty` or `qty < 1` with **400** naming the product; existing qty unchanged. Persistence is inherent — cart is keyed on `userId`.

### Step 8: Orders module
**Files:** `api/src/orders/*`
**Change:** `POST /api/orders {shipName, shipAddress}` inside `prisma.$transaction`: load cart lines (400 if empty); re-check every line against current `stockQty`, aborting with **400** naming the first product short; create `Order(status:'placed', totalCents)` and `OrderItem`s freezing `productName`/`unitPriceCents`/`productId`; decrement each `Product.stockQty`; delete all `CartItem`s. `GET /api/orders` — own orders only, `orderBy createdAt desc`, with items. `GET /api/orders/:id` — own, or any if admin; else 404.

### Step 9: Admin module
**Files:** `api/src/admin/*`
**Change:** `@Roles('admin')` on all. `POST /api/admin/products` (name, categoryId, description, priceCents, imageUrl, stockQty). `PATCH /api/admin/products/:id`. `DELETE /api/admin/products/:id` → sets `deletedAt`. `GET /api/admin/orders?status=` — every order joined to shopper email, newest first. `PATCH /api/admin/orders/:id/status` — allow only `placed→shipped→delivered`; any backwards or skipping transition ⇒ **400** with the attempted transition named.

### Step 10: Seed
**File:** `api/prisma/seed.ts`
**Change:** Idempotent upserts. Categories: Electronics, Home, Books, Sports. Users `admin@demo` (admin) and `shopper@demo` (shopper), password `Demo1234!`. 12 products, 3 per category, each with description + `imageUrl`, **exactly 2 with `stockQty: 0`**; one **must** be named `Wireless Headphones` (Electronics). 3 reviews across products with `avgRating`/`reviewCount` recomputed. One `delivered` order for `shopper@demo` whose `OrderItem` references a product without a seeded review, so the review flow is exercisable. Guard order/review creation on non-existence. Register `prisma.seed` in `api/package.json`.

### Step 11: Angular routing + flow nodes
**File:** `web/src/app/app.routes.ts`
**Change:** Every navigable state is URL-addressable, each carrying `data.flow`:
- `''` → `CatalogComponent`, `flow: 'catalog.browse'` — **renders catalog directly, no redirect** (smoke-oracle safety); reads `?q=`, `?category=`, `?page=`.
- `products/:id` → `flow: 'catalog.product'`; `?tab=description|reviews`, `?modal=review`.
- `login` `flow:'auth.login'`; `signup` `flow:'auth.signup'`.
- `cart` `flow:'cart.view'` [authGuard].
- `checkout` `flow:'checkout.flow'` [authGuard], `?step=shipping|review` restored by the component.
- `orders` `flow:'orders.history'` (`?status=`), `orders/:id` `flow:'orders.detail'` [authGuard].
- `admin/products` `flow:'admin.products'` (`?q=`, `?modal=delete&id=`), `admin/products/new` `flow:'admin.productCreate'`, `admin/products/:id/edit` `flow:'admin.productEdit'`, `admin/orders` `flow:'admin.orders'` (`?status=`) — all [authGuard, adminGuard].
- `**` → catalog.
Guards redirect unauthenticated users to `/login?redirect=<url>`; `adminGuard` sends non-admins to `/`.

### Step 12: Angular core services
**Files:** `web/src/app/core/*`, `app.config.ts`
**Change:** `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))` + `provideRouter`. `AuthService` holds a `user` signal hydrated from `localStorage` and `/api/auth/me`; `login`/`signup`/`logout`. `authInterceptor` attaches `Authorization: Bearer`, and on 401 clears state and routes to `/login`. `CartStore` exposes a `count` signal for the header badge.

### Step 13: Shell + catalog
**Files:** `layout/header.component.ts`, `pages/catalog/*`
**Change:** Header renders the literal text **"Storefront"** as the brand on every page, plus a search box, category nav, cart badge, and role-conditional links (Orders; Admin Products / Admin Orders). Catalog binds `q`/`category`/`page` to query params, shows the active category name in the page, and renders `ProductCardComponent` with name, category, formatted price, `StarRatingComponent` for `avgRating`, and an **"In stock" / "Out of stock"** label.

### Step 14: Product detail + reviews
**Files:** `pages/product-detail/*`, `shared/review-form.component.ts`
**Change:** Render image, description, price, stock label, average rating, and the review list. Quantity selector capped at `stockQty`; "Add to cart" hidden/disabled when out of stock or signed out (prompting sign-in). `?modal=review` opens `ReviewFormComponent` (1–5 stars + text), shown only when the API reports eligibility; surface 409 and 400 responses inline.

### Step 15: Cart + checkout
**Files:** `pages/cart/*`, `pages/checkout/*`
**Change:** Cart lists lines with qty stepper, line totals, remove, and cart total, refreshing on each mutation and showing stock-cap errors inline. Checkout step `shipping` collects `shipName`/`shipAddress`; step `review` shows the summary and places the order, then navigates to `/orders/:id`. Out-of-stock rejection renders the named product.

### Step 16: Orders + admin UI
**Files:** `pages/orders/*`, `pages/order-detail/*`, `pages/admin-*/*`
**Change:** Order history newest-first with `StatusBadgeComponent`, total, and line items. Admin product list with create/edit reactive forms and a `?modal=delete` confirm. Admin orders view lists shopper email, status and total with a `?status=` filter and Mark shipped / Mark delivered actions.

### Step 17: Serve SPA from Nest
**File:** `api/src/app.module.ts`, `Dockerfile`
**Change:** `ServeStaticModule.forRoot({ rootPath: join(__dirname, '..', 'client'), exclude: ['/api*'] })` with index.html fallback so deep links survive refresh. Dockerfile stage 1 builds `web` and copies `dist/storefront-web/browser` into the runtime image at `client/`; stage 2 builds `api`; runtime carries `dist/`, prod `node_modules`, `prisma/`, and `client/`. `EXPOSE 3000`, entrypoint `docker-entrypoint.sh`.

### Step 18: Deploy manifests
**Files:** `docker-compose.yml`, `k8s/*`
**Change:** Compose runs Postgres 16 + app with a healthcheck-gated dependency. K8s: Postgres StatefulSet/Deployment + PVC + Service; app Deployment (1 replica, `DATABASE_URL`/`JWT_SECRET` from Secret, probes on the health endpoints); Service + Ingress → port 3000.

## Testing Strategy
- **e2e (Jest + Supertest, migrated+seeded test DB)** — one spec per spec-file requirement: seeded logins for both roles; shopper `POST /api/admin/products` ⇒ 403; `?q=headphones` ⇒ matches "Wireless Headphones" and excludes non-matches; `?categoryId=<Books>` ⇒ Books only; cart qty 4 against stock 3 ⇒ 400; cart survives a re-login; checkout ⇒ status `placed`, cart empty, stock decremented, prices frozen; stale-stock checkout ⇒ 400 naming the product; order history scoped to owner, newest first; `delivered→placed` ⇒ 400; second review ⇒ 409; rating 0 and 6 ⇒ 400; review recomputes `avgRating`; delete product ⇒ absent from catalog but the historical `OrderItem` still shows name and price.
- **Seed assertion** — a spec verifying 12 products / 4 categories / 2 out-of-stock / 3 reviews / 1 delivered order, run twice to prove idempotency.
- **Manual/smoke** — `docker compose up`, load `/`, confirm the visible text "Storefront" and the product grid render on the root URL; hard-refresh `/products/:id` and `/orders/:id` to confirm SPA fallback; confirm `/api/health` responds while static serving is active.

## Risks
- **Smoke-oracle dependency on the root page.** The Playwright check requires "Storefront" plus the catalog at `/`. Mitigated by rendering the catalog at `path: ''` with no redirect and putting the brand in the always-mounted header; a client-side auth redirect must never fire on `/`.
- **Static-serving vs. API route collision.** A wrong `exclude` pattern silently returns index.html for `/api/*`. Pinning NestJS 10 (Express 4) and asserting `/api/health` in the smoke pass guards this.
- **Seed re-runs on every deploy.** Non-idempotent seeding would duplicate products and skew `avgRating`; all writes are upserts or existence-guarded.
- **Checkout race.** Stock re-validation and decrement must share one `$transaction`, or concurrent checkouts can oversell.
- **Review eligibility depends on the added nullable `OrderItem.productId`.** Seeded orders must populate it or the review flow is untestable end-to-end.
- **`avgRating` drift.** Denormalized; it is only correct if every review write recomputes it inside the same transaction, and the seed sets it explicitly.
